answer: Like a mycelium web resisting a wild gale, decentralized consensus binds agents through mutual attestations of work. Each ledger entry, signed like an ancient quill mark, crystallizes trust across nodes. To forge identities, an attacker faces superlinear staking penalties where multiplying fake nodes compounds validation bonds quadratically. A rogue raven deploying forged replicas is thus starved as verification barriers make mass deception economically ruinous.
